name: The Hub

schedule.note: Aug/Sept through Nov/Dec, and Jan/Feb through May/June

length: Three to five months per term
educational: Project-based group work — games, puzzles, collaborative storytelling and art, research and presenting, video production; jointly selected by participants and facilitators
description: For tweens and teens who want a consistent but part-time cohort experience, with a community they can belong to longer term (before, during and after travels).
reviews: Testimonials in the overview video on the website
